system_thesis: A warm, non-clinical companion object that feels like a piece of home décor rather than a medical device or gadget. The form language draws from organic pebble and smooth stone metaphors — rounded, tactile, approachable — while the CMF strategy (fabric-wrapped body, light wood base, soft-touch matte surfaces) ensures the device blends into a living room shelf or bedside table. Ambient warm LED breathing light (2700K) replaces screens as the primary emotional feedback channel, conveying presence without demanding attention.

palette.strategy: Warm neutral palette anchored in cream and warm gray, with natural wood and amber light as accents. All colors stay below 30% saturation to avoid clinical or toy-like associations. High contrast ratio (text-charcoal on surface-cream = 10.2:1) ensures legibility for aging vision. No cool blues or pure whites — everything carries a warm undertone.

contrast_rules.minimum_text_contrast: 7:1 (WCAG AAA for elderly users with reduced contrast sensitivity)
contrast_rules.button_contrast: 5:1 minimum between button surface and surrounding body
contrast_rules.led_visibility: glow-amber on surface-cream provides soft but visible status indication

roles.family: Humanist sans-serif (e.g., Frutiger, Source Sans Pro)
roles.usage: Product name, hero headlines in presentation materials
Descriptions, instructions — minimum 16pt for elderly readability
Technical specifications, material codes, measurement values

typography.strategy: Humanist sans-serif throughout for warmth and legibility. No serif (too traditional/medical) no geometric sans (too cold/tech). Large minimum sizes (16pt body) accommodate presbyopia. Generous line-height (1.6x) and letter-spacing. Chinese text uses 思源黑体 (Source Han Sans) Regular/Light for consistency.
rules: Body text minimum 16pt / 20px for any user-facing surface
No all-caps for headlines — reduces cognitive load for elderly readers
Line height minimum 1.5x for body text
Chinese + English mixed text: use Source Han Sans for Chinese, Source Sans Pro for English

grid.description: 8px base grid for all spatial relationships. Generous gutters and margins reflect the 'breathing room' design philosophy. Product proportions follow 2:3 and 3:5 ratios (pebble-like, not golden-ratio-precise).

product_proportions.overall_height_to_width: 1.3:1 to 1.5:1 (slightly tall pebble, stable visual weight)

motif_system.name: breathing-arc
motif_system.description: Gentle concentric arcs and soft radial gradients that evoke breathing, heartbeat, and warm light diffusion. Used as ambient light patterns, surface texture direction, and presentation graphic elements.

elements.description: Concentric circular arcs with varying opacity, suggesting a gentle pulse. Used for LED light diffusion pattern and as a decorative motif in presentation boards.
Asymmetric organic curve derived from river stone silhouettes. Used for product silhouette, surface parting lines, and section dividers in presentation materials.
Soft radial gradient from glow-amber center to transparent edge. Used for LED status indication areas and as background atmosphere in renders.

rules: All curves must be G2 continuous — no sharp transitions anywhere
Minimum corner radius on any product edge: 8mm
Motif elements never appear as hard-edged graphics — always soft, diffused, ambient
breath-ring motif aligns with the physical LED ring location on the product
No geometric patterns (hexagons, grids, circuits) — only organic forms

voice.full_description: humanistic + warm + accessible + respectful — speaks to the elderly user as a capable adult, not a patient or child
do_say: 我在這裡，需要什麼都可以告訴我
今天的天氣很適合出去走走
該吃藥了，我幫您記著呢
I'm here whenever you need me
Let's take this one step at a time
tone_principles: Speak as a caring companion, never as a medical monitor
Use simple, short sentences — max 15 Chinese characters per utterance
Acknowledge silence — don't fill every moment with speech
Respect autonomy — 'would you like' not 'you should'

lockup.name_meaning: Companion — the Chinese character 伴 contains 人(person) + 半(other half), suggesting presence alongside
lockup.placement: Subtle laser-etched on wood base, not printed on fabric surface. Never dominates the visual field.
rules: Product name appears only on base or packaging — never on the main visible surface
The device itself has no visible branding — it should feel like a personal object, not a branded product
Packaging uses text-charcoal on surface-cream, humanist sans-serif, generous whitespace

imagery_strategy.approach: People-centered lifestyle imagery with warm, natural lighting. Focus on elderly hands interacting with the device, soft domestic environments (living room shelf, bedside table, kitchen counter), and the device 'at rest' as a décor object. Never show the device in clinical or institutional settings.

lighting.direction: Soft diffused natural light from window, or warm ambient lamp light
lighting.quality: No harsh shadows, no specular highlights on product surface (matte finish)
lighting.time_of_day: Late afternoon golden hour or cozy evening lamplight

subjects.primary: Elderly hands (wrinkled, warm skin tones) gently touching or near the device
subjects.secondary: Domestic environments — wooden shelves, linen textiles, ceramic cups, plants
subjects.avoid: Faces of elderly users (privacy/dignity), medical equipment, institutional interiors, children

composition.framing: Medium close-up, device at eye level or slightly below (respectful perspective)
composition.depth_of_field: Shallow — device sharp, background softly blurred
composition.negative_space: Generous — the device should breathe in the frame, never crowded

color_grading.overall: Warm lift in shadows, slightly desaturated highlights, cream midtones
color_grading.reference: Kinfolk magazine aesthetic — quiet, warm, natural, unhurried
color_grading.avoid: High contrast HDR, cool blue casts, saturated colors, clinical white balance

asset_usage_policy.reference_images: 13 peer/other references available in research/assets/. All allowed for edit reference. Do not directly copy any competitor's signature form (ElliQ head+ring, PARO fur, MiRo animal shape, Buddy screen-face).
asset_usage_policy.generated_artifacts: All PNGs generated via image_generate. No image_edit needed (no official brand assets to preserve). Reference images inform style and context but are not composited into deliverables.
prohibited: No medical/clinical imagery (stethoscopes, hospital beds, white coats)
No child-like or toy-like aesthetics (bright primary colors, cartoon faces)
No surveillance/monitoring visual language (camera lenses, scanning beams, data dashboards)
No pure black or pure white surfaces — everything warm-toned
No sharp edges or angular geometry in product form
No visible screws, seams, or technical details on exterior surfaces

do_not_use: pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) — always warm-toned alternatives
sharp 90° corners on product form — minimum 8mm radius everywhere
medical/clinical white or sterile blue color associations
screen-as-face UI (avoid Buddy-style screen face that enters uncanny valley)
visible technical details (screws, vents, seams) on primary surfaces
high-saturation accent colors (no bright red, electric blue, neon green)
generic AI/tech motifs (circuit patterns, neural networks, glowing nodes, hex grids)
surveillance aesthetic (camera lenses prominently displayed, scanning indicators)
childish/toy-like design language (primary colors, cartoon expressions)
